card.name: The before prescriber in antidepressant warnings
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "communication with" in the antidepressant suicidality warning about caregivers watching for worsening. It expects "prescriber" next.

modes.label: Caregiver communication sentence
modes.description: "the" after "close observation and communication with" in the boxed warning for antidepressants.
modes.example: Families and caregivers should be advised of the need for close observation and communication with<< the>> prescriber. Fluvoxamine male

card.writes: It suppresses words like consult, consultation and professional, which steers the next word away from them and toward "prescriber".
card.plain: It fires on the word "the" in the antidepressant warning telling families to stay in touch with the prescriber.
